drums.tags: Indie rock with a prominent post-punk revival influence. The track features a driving, overdriven electric bass guitar playing a repetitive eighth-note riff that anchors the arrangement. Two electric guitars are present: one playing clean, palm-muted rhythmic patterns and another providing melodic lead lines with light chorus and delay. The drum kit maintains a steady, straightforward beat with a crisp snare and tight hi-hats. The tempo is 120 BPM in the key of A minor. The production is clean with moderate reverb on the guitars, creating a spacious but focused soundstage. The structure alternates between bass-driven grooves and melodic guitar interplay.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[overdriven electric bass enters with eighth-note riff]
[clean electric guitar enters with palm-muted rhythmic pattern]

[Section A]
[drums enter with steady backbeat and closed hi-hats]
[lead electric guitar enters with melodic, chorused riff]

[Section B]
[bass continues driving riff]
[rhythm guitar shifts to open chords]
[lead guitar plays higher register melodic accents with delay]

[Outro]
[drums and lead guitar drop out]
[bass and rhythm guitar fade out]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long decay that creates a rhythmic rumble. A sharp, metallic snare hits on the backbeat. A syncopated, percussive synth sequence with a high-pass filter sweep runs throughout. Distorted, gritty bass pulses in sixteenth notes. Industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and white noise bursts, are processed with short room reverb. The tempo is 130 BPM in the key of D minor. The arrangement builds through the addition of layered percussion and high-frequency glitch textures.

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum with sub-bass rumble]
[syncopated metallic percussion enters]

[Section A]
[sixteenth-note gritty bass pulse]
[sharp snare on beats 2 and 4]
[high-pass filtered synth sequence begins]

[Section B]
[white noise bursts and industrial clangs]
[layered hi-hats and glitch textures]
[filter resonance increases on synth sequence]

[Outro]
[percussion layers drop out]
[fading distorted kick and sub-bass rumble]
